watches.name: A3 Meteorite (Pre-Order)
watches.description: The A3 Meteorite is the first official Meteorite watch in the Alexander James portfolio. From the beginning, the goal was always to do more than simply showcase the material. On the heels of two releases that utilized two different finishes on a single dial, the next idea emerged. What happens when dual finishes meets meteorite? The answer was a Dual Acid Washed Dial. The A3 Meteorite doesn't forget the brand's roots. While dial's 12-3-6-9 index layout is a nod to the first larger scale release, the NDR001 , the A3 case is the more modern, refined A3 hardware featured in the Omen series. T he A3 case uses 316L stainless steel with different brushed and polished surfaces. The bracelet tapers to 16mm at the clasp, which features tool-less micro-adjust. Note : Meteorite is a natural material — no two dials will look exactly the same, and both shift noticeably under different lighting. This watch is assembled, regulated, and tested by AJ, who has been assembling watches for over 10 years. These watches are expected to ship in mid-September Limited to 30 pieces

watches.description: Experience the distinction of true artisanal watchmaking with Maison Cacek's hand-crafted dials. Each piece originates from his personal sketches, refined through digital precision before undergoing engraving and finishing. His hands polish, paint, and lacquer every dial, experimenting with exclusive finish combinations and color formulations. Specifically designed for the A3 Omen case, these dials represent a rare opportunity to own a timepiece where genuine craftsmanship and artistic vision converge—a watch that tells the story of one artisan's unwavering commitment to excellence and individuality. These watches are powered by the Miyota 9039 movement and is housed by the A3 case, first featured in the A3 Omens. The case and bracelet offer a more refined, premium finishing where you'll notice the various different cuts and finishing. The bracelet also features a tool-less microadjust clasp! This watch is assembled, regulated, and tested by AJ, who has been assembling watches for over 10 years. Limited 1/1 Piece

watches.name: A3 Tavern Style
watches.description: When people think of Chicago style pizza, they picture Deep Dish, but we locals think of a Thin Crust also known as Tavern Style. Back in the 1940s, this square cut pizza was made for sharing at, well, taverns. This pizza is the basis of Alexander James' most playful release yet. In collaboration with Red5WatchWorks and AndoAndoAndo, the A3 Tavern Style uses an embossed dial that captures the look of a Chicago Tavern Style Pizza to near perfection. The dial is "sliced" into squares with grooves in the dial and features pepperonis that are raised above the cheese! If you look close enough, there are 3 pepperonis with logos of collaborators on them! The A3 Tavern style is powered by the suitably thin Miyota 9039 movement and is housed by the A3 case, first featured in the A3 Omens. The case and bracelet offer a more refined, premium finishing where you'll notice the various different cuts and finishing. The bracelet also features a tool-less microadjust clasp! Each A3 Tavern Style is hand tossed, put in the oven, and taste tested by AJ who has been eating pizza for over 30 years (and by that I mean assembled, regulated, and tested by AJ, who has been assembling watches for over 10 years). Each A3 Tavern Style is made to order. Please allow 5 business days for assembly and testing before shipment. Limited to 15 pieces

This version features a stunning Aventurine dial. Each and every A3 Omen is hand assembled, regulated, and tested by AJ, who has been assembling watches for over 10 years. All A3 Omen watches will be hand assembled, regulated, and tested in Chicago. Updates to photographed prototypes : The bracelets will taper to 16mm and use a quick open clasp with an easy microadjust on the underside. Limited to 100 pieces
